'''Fabrizio Bucella''' (born 11 December 1973) is a Belgian physicist, author, and sommelier of Italian origin. He is a professor at the [[Université libre de Bruxelles]], where he teaches physics and mathematics. Bucella is also a well-known science communicator and media personality, appearing regularly on television and radio in Belgium and France to discuss scientific topics, wine, and beer. He has authored several books on oenology and zythology.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=“L’anti-guide de la bière” : Fabrizio Bucella répond aux questions autour du célèbre breuvage |url=https://bx1.be/categories/news/lanti-guide-de-la-biere-fabrizio-bucella-repond-aux-questions-autour-du-celebre-breuvage/ |website=BX1 |publisher=BX1officiel |date=17 April 2023 |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=fr}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Bucella was born in [[Milan]], Italy, to Italian parents.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Soro |first=Antonella |title=Fabrizio Bucella, le prof de physique le plus célèbre de Belgique, se confie à Ciné-Télé-Revue : « J’ai toujours été perçu comme un Martien » |url=https://www.sudinfo.be/id1161320/article/2026-06-15/fabrizio-bucella-le-prof-de-physique-le-plus-celebre-de-belgique-se-confie-cine |date=15 June 2026 |website=[[Groupe Sudmedia|Sudinfo]] |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=fr}}</ref> He moved to Belgium at the age of five, initially speaking no French. His father worked as a [[proofreader]] for the Italian newspaper ''[[Corriere della Sera]]'', and his mother was a German teacher. His interest in science was sparked by an astrophysics lecture at his school and by reading [[Stephen Hawking]]'s ''[[A Brief History of Time]]''.

While studying physics at the [[Université libre de Bruxelles]], Bucella became the president of the [[Fédération des étudiants francophones]] (FEF) in July 1995, succeeding [[Philippe Henry]].<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Bouillon |first1=Pierre |last2=Tellier |first2=Didier |title=Bucella, le petit Galilée de la cause étudiante |url=https://www.lesoir.be/art/bucella-le-petit-galilee-de-la-cause-etudiante_t-19951017-Z0A5MZ.html |date=17 October 1995 |website=[[Le Soir]] |access-date=1 October 2026 |language=fr}}</ref> He went on to earn a [[doctorate]] in physics.

== Career ==
Bucella is a professor of physics and mathematics at the Université libre de Bruxelles. In addition to his academic work, he has been involved in political spheres, serving in the cabinets of socialist ministers [[Françoise Dupuis]] and [[Marie Arena]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Voogt |first=Fabrice |title=La FEF: un tremplin pour la politique |url=https://www.lesoir.be/art/d-20130910-31MVGH |date=10 September 2013 |website=[[Le Soir]] |access-date=1 October 2026 |language=fr}}</ref>

His career as a science communicator took off in 2022 when he began posting educational videos on social media platforms, including [[Instagram]] and [[TikTok]], encouraged by his students. His videos quickly gained popularity, and by 2026, he had accumulated over 1.2 million subscribers across his various platforms.

Starting around 2025, Bucella achieved broader notoriety through regular appearances on Belgian television, notably on the [[RTBF]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Packiry |first=Kessava |title=Il est l’un des visages des «Grosses têtes». Jeune, le truculent Professeur Fabrizio Bucella a passé toutes ses vacances à Fribourg |url=https://www.laliberte.ch/articles/societe/jeune-le-truculent-professeur-fabrizio-bucella-a-passe-toutes-ses-vacances-a-fribourg-1253377 |date=29 November 2025 |website=La Liberté |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=fr}}</ref> and [[LN24]]<ref>{{Cite web |last=Valet |first=Fred |title=Selon ce prof de physique, «il faut péter dans les F-35» |url=https://www.watson.ch/fr/divertissement/sante/536240373-selon-ce-prof-de-physique-il-faut-peter-dans-les-f-35 |date=21 May 2026 |website=watson.ch/fr |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=fr}}</ref> networks. He also became a regular panelist on the popular French radio show ''[[Les Grosses Têtes]]'' on [[RTL (French radio)|RTL]]. During the summer of 2026, he hosted a science segment on [[France Inter]].<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |title=Fabrizio Bucella, physicien star des réseaux sociaux : "J'étais un élève extrêmement turbulent" |url=https://www.radiofrance.fr/franceinter/podcasts/le-grand-portrait/le-grand-portrait-du-jeudi-04-juin-2026-4412914 |date=4 June 2026 |website=France Inter |access-date=9 August 2026 |language=fr}}</ref>

Bucella is also a recognized [[sommelier]] and has written several books focusing on wine and beer appreciation, aiming to make oenology and zythology accessible to a wider audience.
